stories.title: Flintshire Cabinet accused of ‘party politics’ over £516k for Flintshire schools
stories.summary: Flintshire’s ruling coalition has been accused of putting party politics before children after its Cabinet voted against returning £516,000 to education. stories.title: Flintshire village clears final hurdle to adopt Welsh name Pentre Moch
stories.summary: Northop Hall has been granted permission to formally adopt its historic welsh name – Pentre Moch. Flintshire County Council has formally approved the official use of Pentre Moch – which translates as ‘Pig Holding’ or ‘Pig Village’ – as the primary Welsh name for the village.
